description: This file contains a JavaScript module for generating PowerPoint presentations using the PptxGenJS library. It includes functions for data URL handling, value transformations, slide and presentation creation based on schemas and form data, and exposes a single exported function generatePptx that constructs and returns a PPTX Blob and filename.

methods.name: isProbablyDataUrl(v)
methods.description: Checks whether a given string is a data URL.

methods.name: fileToDataUrl(file)
methods.description: Converts a File object or string into a data URL asynchronously.

methods.name: applyTransform(value, transformName)
methods.description: Applies a specified transformation to a value, such as formatting percent or currency, or converting bullets to lines.

methods.name: resolveDeckTitle(wizardSchema, formData)
methods.description: Determines the title for the presentation based on form data or fallback logic.

methods.name: safeFileName(name)
methods.description: Generates a safe filename string from a presentation title.

methods.name: generatePptx({ templateModel, wizardSchema, formData })
methods.description: Main function to generate a PowerPoint presentation Blob and filename based on provided templates and schema.

ctags.name: generatePptx
ctags.pattern: /^export async function generatePptx({ templateModel, wizardSchema, formData }) {$/
